# A const-switch case that boxes a closure whose body receives into a
# case-local type must eject to Go that builds and runs like the native
# build: the alias splice for the local type composes into the boxed
# operand's replacement instead of overlapping it.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^true$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/boxed

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
// Command boxed exercises eject of a boxed const-switch closure whose
// comma-ok receive names a case-local type.
package main

import "fmt"

type Box struct{ S string }

func (b Box) M() string { return "box:" + b.S }

func f[T any](v T) interface{ M() string } {
	const switch T {
	case interface{ M() string }:
		var p interface{ M() string }
		ch := make(chan T, 1)
		ch <- v
		p = func() T {
			type Status bool
			var ok Status
			p, ok = <-ch
			_ = ok
			return v
		}()
		return p
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	p := f[Box](Box{S: "x"})
	fmt.Println(p != nil && p.M() == "box:x")
}
